name: Left_CCDAngle
details: Angle between the femoral shaft axis and femoral neck axis, reported on the medial side of the intersection.

name: Left_AcetabularIndexTonnis
details: Signed angle between the user-defined Acetabular Index (Tönnis) line and the side-specific lateral horizontal arm; values above the reference arm are positive and below it are negative.

name: Left_SharpAngle
details: Signed angle between the user-defined Sharp line and the side-specific lateral horizontal arm; values above the reference arm are positive and below it are negative.

name: Left_LCEAngle
details: Signed angle from the femur head center to the LCE point against the superior line perpendicular to the reference line; medial points are negative.

name: Left_FemoralHeadExtrusionIndex
details: Signed percent ratio of uncovered lateral femoral head width over total femoral head width; negative values indicate overcoverage beyond the lateral head margin.

name: Left_CCR
details: Canal-calcar ratio (B/A): width between the two inner 10 cm-below morphology points divided by the mid-LT guide-cap width.

name: Left_CTI
details: Canal thickness index: outer 10 cm-below width minus inner 10 cm-below width, divided by outer 10 cm-below width.

name: Left_CFI
details: Canal flare index: 2 cm-above width divided by the width between the two inner 10 cm-below morphology points.

name: Left_PreOp_GlobalOffset
details: Numerical sum of the pre-operative acetabular offset and femoral offset.

name: Left_AcetabularInclinationAngle_FreeHand_PostOp
details: Acute angle between the side-specific free-hand inclination line and the reference line.

name: Left_CupOpeningEllipseFit_Inclination_PostOp
details: Acute angle between the fitted cup opening ellipse major diameter and the reference line.

name: Left_CupAnteversionRetroversionAngle_PostOp
details: Theta = asin(minor diameter / major diameter) from the fitted cup opening ellipse diameters.

name: Left_ImplantFemoralCCD_PostOp

name: Left_PostOp_GlobalOffset
details: Numerical sum of the post-operative acetabular offset and femoral offset.

name: Left_StemAlignment
details: Acute angle difference between the derived stem axis and the femoral shaft axis.

name: Left_PostOp_ProjectedHeadPenetration
